products.name: boAt Rockerz 550 ANC
products.tagline: Over-ear wireless headphones with 45 dB hybrid ANC
products.description: 40 mm dynamic drivers, 45 dB hybrid noise cancellation and a 60-hour battery — the Rockerz 550 ANC is boAt's most returned-to workhorse. Dual-device Bluetooth 5.3 with low-latency BEAST mode for BGMI and a plush memory-foam headband that survives a full commute.
features: 45 dB hybrid ANC with transparency mode

specs.label: Box contents
specs.value: Headphones, Type-C cable, 3.5 mm AUX, warranty card

products.name: boAt Airdopes 161
products.tagline: TWS earbuds with 8H playback and ENx mic
products.description: The everyday Airdopes: 13 mm bass drivers, ENx environmental noise cancellation for calls on a busy street, IPX4 sweat resistance and a case that adds 36 hours. BatchSync pairing connects in under two seconds — the reason this is the most-ordered SKU on Shop Cart.
features: 36 hours total with the charging case

specs.label: Box contents
specs.value: Earbuds, case, Type-C cable, 3 sizes of tips

products.name: Portronics Roar 4 Plus
products.tagline: 24 W portable Bluetooth speaker with dual passive radiators
products.description: Two 48 mm drivers, dual passive radiators that visibly move, and 12 hours of runtime at 60% volume. TWS-pair two Roar 4 units for stereo, take the IPX7 body to the pool, and charge it from the same Type-C cable as your phone.
features: 24 W RMS with dual passive radiators

products.name: Noise ColorFit Pro 5 Alpha
products.tagline: 1.85" AMOLED smartwatch with BT calling and GPS
products.description: A 1.85-inch AMOLED at 1,000 nits that stays readable under Indian afternoon sun, Bluetooth calling with 200 contacts, built-in sports GPS, SpO2 and 125+ workout modes. Seven days of battery in normal use, 400+ watch faces, and IP68 for monsoon commutes.

products.name: Redmi Note 14 Pro 5G
products.tagline: 108 MP OIS camera, Snapdragon 7s Gen 3, 5,110 mAh
products.warranty: 1 year Mi India warranty + 6 months on display
products.description: The Note franchise at its most complete: a 108 MP main sensor with optical stabilisation, a 120 Hz AMOLED that peaks at 3,000 nits, IP68 dust-and-water sealing and 45 W turbo charging. India-launched HyperOS 2 with four years of security updates.
features: 108 MP OIS main + 8 MP ultrawide + 2 MP macro

specs.label: Camera
specs.value: 108 MP OIS + 8 MP + 2 MP | 20 MP front

products.name: Acer Aspire Lite i5
products.tagline: 12th Gen Core i5 thin-and-light with 16 GB RAM
products.warranty: 1 year onsite warranty + 2 years on battery/adapter
products.description: A 12th-gen Intel Core i5-12450H, 16 GB of DDR4 and a 512 GB NVMe SSD in a 1.7 kg chassis with a backlit keyboard. The 14.1-inch Full HD IPS panel covers 90% sRGB — enough for editing college fests and client cuts on the local train.
features: Intel Core i5-12450H, up to 4.4 GHz
Wi-Fi 6, USB-C with DP, backlit keyboard

products.name: Zebronics Fusion Striker Pro
products.tagline: Outemu blue switch mechanical keyboard with RGB
products.description: Full-size 104-key layout with hot-swappable Outemu blue switches, double-shot keycaps that survive a cyber-café decade, per-key RGB with 18 modes and a dedicated media roller. Wired 1 ms polling, no software bloat, works out of the box on Windows and Linux.

products.name: Redgear Vector Wireless
products.tagline: Hall-effect wireless gamepad for PC, Android and TV
products.description: Redgear's answer to stick drift: hall-effect thumbsticks, 400 Hz polling over the 2.4 GHz dongle, a 1,000 mAh cell that lasts 22 hours, and mapping profiles that save to the pad itself. Plays BGMI, Steam and NVIDIA GRID without a driver install.
features: 2.4 GHz dongle, Bluetooth 5.0 and USB-C wired

products.name: pTron Vrity Lite
products.tagline: VR headset for phones with adjustable focus
products.description: Slot in any 4.7–6.5-inch phone and the 45 mm optical lenses give a 110° field of view with myopia adjustment from -6D. Cloud-foam face padding, a head strap that does not crush your hair, and free access to pTron's VR app library with 2,000+ 360° videos.
features: 110° field of view, 45 mm optical glass

specs.label: Box contents
specs.value: Headset, strap, cleaning cloth, VR remote

products.name: Zebronics Zeb-Fame Pro
products.tagline: 16 MP digital camera with 16x interpolation and 2.7" LCD
products.description: A genuinely affordable camera for college fests, shop documentation and YouTube starting out: 16 MP sensor, 16x digital interpolation, 1080p video, face detection and a 2.7-inch LCD that tilts for self-framing. Runs two hours on a rechargeable pack.

reviews.name: Rhea Mendonça
reviews.text: Ordered the Rockerz at 11 pm, delivered by 10 am next day in Koramangala. ANC is genuinely good for the price — the metro announcement system disappears.

reviews.name: Aditya Rakesh
reviews.text: Airdopes survived a monsoon commute and four hours of BGMI. The case is small enough to forget in a jeans pocket.

reviews.name: Sneha Iyer
reviews.text: Bought the Zeb-Fame for my shop's Instagram. Daylight shots are clean and the tilt LCD makes self-recording easy. GST invoice arrived the same hour.

reviews.name: Mohd Faizan
reviews.text: Redgear finally made a pad that does not drift. Used it on a TV with GeForce Now for three weeks — zero stick issues, charging is Type-C too.

reviews.name: Kavya Nair
reviews.text: The Noise watch display is readable at noon on the beach and I got seven days before charging. Call audio quality over BT is better than expected.

reviews.name: Harsh Vardhan
reviews.text: No-cost EMI on the Acer was the reason I bought. Body is light, keyboard feels nice for long typing, and it handles Premiere 1080p fine.
